pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.8
pack.summary: Release V2.4.8. 6 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Fixes a bug that stopped the launcher being set up at all: if you picked your mods folder in the folder chooser — which is exactly what the chooser's own title told you to pick — it was rejected with a message that read as though your mods were missing. Either folder now works: choose your Minecraft folder or the mods folder inside it, and the launcher works out the rest and shows you the exact folder it will install into. It also now looks for your Minecraft installation on startup and offers it, so most people no longer need to go hunting for the folder at all — it always asks first and never adopts a folder on its own. One thing unchanged: a mods folder that is completely empty is still not accepted, because a folder with nothing in it cannot be told apart from an unrelated folder of the same name.
